title: Sliding-Window Streaming VLMs: Full Evaluation — Qwen3.8-27B vs Muse Glimmer 30B
summary: Qwen3.8-27B and Muse Glimmer 30B run as causal online assistants (an 8-frame sliding window plus a memory they write themselves, replayed in media time) on every eligible item of Ego-MC-Bench (39 videos) and the Wearable AI validation split (2,056 sessions): about 140k model calls per model, scored with the official or adapted evaluators, plus an isolated single-stream latency study.

title: Human–Device Simulation — a rigged human operating a microwave and a desktop printer (3D render + MuJoCo contact)
summary: Reproducible 3D pipeline: a clothed MPFB human with IK-driven hands operates a CC BY 4.0 microwave model and a generic desktop printer in Blender; each device's key (microwave START, printer OK) is driven by MuJoCo contact against a kinematic fingertip proxy with a negative control; door, knob, bowl, paper tray and paper stack use labelled assisted grasps; the turntable, interior light, display and printed sheet are labelled motor or illustrative effects. Two recorded runs (microwave 51 s, printer 35 s) rendered from external, first-person and hand-detail cameras (preview quality). 2026-10-11: four task videos on the procedural Samsung-style microwave (cook, reheat, defrost, set clock; 10 measured key presses); a procedural Breville-style espresso machine and a Frigidaire-style induction range are modelled with their own task sets (videos in progress); the old microwave runs stay on the page.
